description:
Location groups
List every valid location for the `activity_location` and `org_location` filters on `stories_organization_list` and `stories_industry_location_list`. Returns all ~430 groups in `results`, in one response (no paging), as a hierarchy: UN regions (e.g. "Asia", "Southern Asia"), then countries by ISO code (e.g. "IN", "FR"), then states or provinces for the US (via Census regions such as "Midwest"), AE, CA, CN and IN (e.g. "US-TX" is Texas, "CA-08" is Ontario). Each item has `id` (pass this, or `name` such as "texas", to the filters), `name`, `parent` and `children` (links to the groups above and below it). Filtering on a group includes everything beneath it. Free: no API key or payment needed.
name: location_groups_list

children.description: List of child location group URLs

id.description: Location Group unique ID (e.g. can be a UN region name like 'Asia' or an ISO code like 'US-TX')

name.description: Name for this location group. For UN and US regions this will be the same as the ID

title: Location groups
